about: Max payne 3 carries the series' bullet-time grammar into rockstar's production scale: max washed up in sao paulo as private security, and the campaign runs on shoot-dodge dives, last-man-slowmo kills and a cover system that keeps the noir monologue intact. The comic-panel cutaways became full motion design, and the multiplayer's gang wars rode the same gunplay.
Rockstar studios shipped it in may 2012, and the steam listing is the current official door, still sold. The windows build is the original platform - not a port chasing a console lead.
The r age engine build is demanding for its year - the haswell igpu bar means reduced settings, with 1080p above it. Not-tested stands until a run confirms install, launch and saves.
